implementation: Implemented TWAP, volume-profile VWAP, capped Iceberg, explicit-weight batched entry and batched exit; added versioned specs, human-only activation, activation-bound proposal-only recommendations, and a deterministic planner that owns quantities and child schedules.

tests.v5_regression: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run pytest tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py -q
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy, secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 13 property, 874 contract, and health passed

acceptance_mapping.registered_only: AlgorithmSpec versions must be registered and human-activated; recommendation checks the immutable activation snapshot and deterministic planning rechecks the current registry digest/version.
acceptance_mapping.proposal_only_agent: AdvancedExecutionRecommendation contains algorithm, version, activation digest, intent and rationale, but no quantity, child order, submit method or execution authority.
acceptance_mapping.deterministic_owner: AdvancedExecutionPlanner validates intent and slice bounds, then creates content-addressed DeterministicExecutionPlan children.
acceptance_mapping.quantity_conservation: TWAP/VWAP/batched schedules use deterministic whole-lot largest-remainder allocation; Iceberg caps displayed children and refuses insufficient capacity. Property tests cover randomized parent quantities, slice counts and volume profiles.
acceptance_mapping.algorithm_coverage: Contract tests cover TWAP timing, VWAP profile allocation, Iceberg display limits, batched entry/exit, stale activation, wrong intent and non-human activation.

limitations: Plans are simulation execution plans and never route real orders.
Venue-specific fill quality remains governed by the selected L1-L5 matching model and V5-006 calibration.
model_output_not_authoritative: Agent output remains a recommendation; registry state and deterministic planner tests decide executable schedules.
